title: InsightOutput
description: Insight data structure output by insight-engine and rendered by app-ui and data-sync

peakHour.description: Human readable time window of peak focus (e.g. '09:00 - 11:00 AM')

procrastinationTrigger.description: Detected pattern or context where tasks stall or fail (e.g. 'Writing tasks scheduled after 3:00 PM')

recommendation.description: Actionable coaching advice for the user
